title: Beautiful fabric, colour is exact
body: The saree drapes beautifully and the colour matches the photos exactly. Delivered well packed within 3 days to Dhaka.

title: Good quality, slightly long
body: Nice material but a little longer than expected — easy to hem though. Would buy again.

title: Great for Eid, runs slightly large
body: Fabric is soft and breathable. Ordered M, felt closer to L — check the size chart carefully.

title: Authentic handloom, worth it
body: You can tell this is genuinely hand-woven. Arrived in a cloth bag, not crushed. Second purchase from this seller.

title: Nice but arrived a bit late
body: The saree itself is lovely but delivery took 6 days instead of the estimated 3.
